title: Screaming Treess
description: Causes trees to sometimes scream when they are cut down
body:
Ever felt like your world wasn't loud enough? Have you ever wished for the ability to know the feelings of trees? Or do you just feel like pranking your friends? If yes then this mod is just for you! With this mod whenever you cut down a tree there is a chance that it will scream out in agony!

New features:
- 4 amazing screams for your tree friends
- new gamerule: TreeScreamProbability(100(-> 1/100) by default)

This mod is a little something I made a long while ago and left it to rot on my disc. I don't know why I came back and reworked it.
